title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #9

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A family keeps a Tulsi plant at home. What is a good daily habit for them? (1 mark)
   A. Cut it down
   B. Burn it
   C. Ignore it
   D. Water it every morning

2. Which element is called Vayu? (1 mark)
   A. Fire
   B. Air
   C. Space
   D. Earth

3. Which sacred river of India did the lesson say is honoured as a goddess in the stories? (1 mark)
   A. Ganga
   B. Beas
   C. Rijubalika
   D. Nzoia

4. What does the Sanskrit word Panch mean in Panch Mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Ten
   C. Five
   D. Seven

5. What does Lord Narsimha look like? (1 mark)
   A. A fish
   B. A man's body with a lion's head and claws
   C. A snake
   D. A bird

6. Match the being to the teaching. Which pair is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Ram Das: Cruelty
   B. Narsimha: Greed
   C. Buddha: Pride
   D. Parshvanath: Ahimsa

7. Which Jain scripture gives advice on a disciplined life? (1 mark)
   A. Uttaradhyayan Sutra
   B. Sigalovada Sutta
   C. Dhammapada
   D. Ramayan

8. What does the essence of a scripture mean? (1 mark)
   A. Its price
   B. Its length
   C. Its most important message
   D. Its cover

9. Which is a mistake about scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Listening carefully
   B. Keeping it clean
   C. Making fun of another faith's holy book
   D. Reading with respect

10. What does vidya mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Friend
   B. Father
   C. Knowledge
   D. Wealth

11. In Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva, whom does the prayer speak to? (1 mark)
   A. A king
   B. A tree
   C. God
   D. A river

12. Which is the first line of the Gayatri Mantra? (1 mark)
   A. Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah
   B. Om Namah Shivaya
   C. Ya Kundendu Tushara
   D. Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva

13. On which date is International Yoga Day? (1 mark)
   A. 1 June
   B. 12 December
   C. 25 December
   D. 21 June

14. How do we breathe in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Only through the mouth quickly
   B. Through the nose, slowly
   C. In gasps
   D. Not at all

15. What does Vajra mean in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Diamond or thunderbolt
   B. Hare
   C. Moon
   D. Bellows

16. Which is an act of Prani Daya? (1 mark)
   A. Throwing stones at a dog
   B. Breaking plants
   C. Wasting food
   D. Giving water to a thirsty animal

17. What does Prani mean? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A plant only
   C. A stone
   D. A living being

18. What did King Shibi offer to save the dove? (1 mark)
   A. His crown
   B. His own flesh, weight for weight
   C. His shoes
   D. His horse

19. Which principle is about kindness to all living beings? (1 mark)
   A. Punarjanam
   B. Prani Daya
   C. Purushartha
   D. Paramatma

20. What does Dharma mean? (1 mark)
   A. The right way of living
   B. A river
   C. A festival
   D. A sport

21. According to Hindu belief, what does the soul do after death? (1 mark)
   A. Turns to stone
   B. Takes a new body
   C. Turns into a tree only
   D. Ends forever

22. How should we treat others who hold different beliefs about death? (1 mark)
   A. Laugh
   B. Argue
   C. Ignore them
   D. Listen with respect

23. Which activity is suggested to learn about festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Watch television all day
   B. Write a composition on your favourite festival
   C. Copy a friend's essay
   D. Read a book quietly

24. What does Utsav mean? (1 mark)
   A. River
   B. Prayer
   C. Festival
   D. Yoga

25. Which two heavenly bodies besides the five planets are counted as grahas? (1 mark)
   A. The stars and clouds
   B. Earth and Pluto
   C. The Sun and Earth
   D. The Sun and the Moon

26. Som is another name for which heavenly body? (1 mark)
   A. The Sun
   B. Jupiter
   C. The Moon
   D. Saturn

27. Which activity helps you learn the days and planets? (1 mark)
   A. Painting
   B. Copying from a book
   C. Making a decorated calendar
   D. Hiding the calendar

28. What does graha mean in this tradition? (1 mark)
   A. A house
   B. A heavenly body
   C. A festival
   D. A river

29. What does the Moon do in modern science? (1 mark)
   A. It is a planet
   B. It is a star
   C. It goes around the Earth
   D. It goes around Mars

30. Which is the largest planet in the solar system? (1 mark)
   A. Mercury
   B. Venus
   C. Mars
   D. Jupiter

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain why a child should understand the meaning of a prayer. (4 marks)

32. List three things you should do before starting yoga. (3 marks)

33. Explain the importance of celebrating Madaraka Day. (3 marks)

34. Tell the story of the Ayodhya Kaand in three sentences. (3 marks)

35. Why should we visit a friend's festival respectfully? (3 marks)

36. Explain how children who find it hard to speak can join in prayers at assembly. (4 marks)

37. Explain how the story of Prahlad shows faith in Paramatma. (3 marks)

38. Name two things a lost and found corner needs. (2 marks)

39. Give two safety rules for yoga. (2 marks)

40. Which festival in the lesson is a national holiday and why? (2 marks)

41. Give two ways water is used at home. (2 marks)

42. Describe how Maha Shivratri is celebrated. (3 marks)

43. Explain how you can show integrity when using the internet. (3 marks)

44. Explain how a person shows integrity when handling money. (3 marks)

45. Explain the meaning of karma. (3 marks)

46. What does the word Panch Mahabhoot mean? (2 marks)

47. Write a short composition on a festival of your choice. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Water it every morning
   Watering the Tulsi is part of caring for it.

2. B — Air
   Vayu means air and wind.

3. A — Ganga
   In the stories Ganga is honoured as a goddess.

4. C — Five
   Panch means five, and there are five great elements.

5. B — A man's body with a lion's head and claws
   He is shown as a man-lion.

6. D — Parshvanath: Ahimsa
   Parshvanath is linked with non-violence.

7. A — Uttaradhyayan Sutra
   It teaches Ahimsa, truth and control of anger.

8. C — Its most important message
   The essence is the main lesson inside.

9. C — Making fun of another faith's holy book
   We should respect all scriptures.

10. C — Knowledge
   Vidya is knowledge.

11. C — God
   It speaks to God as parent and friend.

12. A — Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah
   The Gayatri Mantra begins Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah.

13. D — 21 June
   21 June.

14. B — Through the nose, slowly
   We breathe calmly through the nose.

15. A — Diamond or thunderbolt
   Vajra means diamond or thunderbolt.

16. D — Giving water to a thirsty animal
   Kindness to living beings.

17. D — A living being
   Prani is a living creature.

18. B — His own flesh, weight for weight
   He offered himself.

19. B — Prani Daya
   Prani Daya is compassion.

20. A — The right way of living
   Dharma includes duty, honesty and kindness.

21. B — Takes a new body
   This is rebirth.

22. D — Listen with respect
   Respect for others is a value.

23. B — Write a composition on your favourite festival
   Writing helps us reflect.

24. C — Festival
   Utsav means festival.

25. D — The Sun and the Moon
   The seven days link to Sun, Moon and five planets.

26. C — The Moon
   Som is the Moon.

27. C — Making a decorated calendar
   Decorating helps memory.

28. B — A heavenly body
   Graha is a heavenly body.

29. C — It goes around the Earth
   The Moon is Earth's natural satellite.

30. D — Jupiter
   Jupiter is the biggest.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: Understanding makes the prayer come from the heart, helps us remember it, and helps us live by its message. Rushing without meaning makes it only a habit.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point, up to 4.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wear loose clothes, prepare a mat, have an empty stomach, find a quiet place, meet with a teacher (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: It reminds us of Kenya's step to self-government on 1 June 1963, teaches patriotism and unity, and lets us respect the flag and the anthem.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Dasharatha was about to hand the kingdom to Ram, but Kaikeyi asked that Bharat be king and Ram go to the forest for fourteen years. Ram accepted calmly and left with Sita and Lakshman. Bharat placed Ram's sandals on the throne and ruled in his name.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three correct points.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: We listen, ask polite questions, do not laugh at customs, and build peace among communities.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: They can hum, listen, join the actions or be helped by friends, so nobody is left out.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four sensible points.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Prahlad believed God is everywhere, kept praying when his father was angry, and was protected.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: A box or table for found items and a book to record the date and finder (any two sensible items).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: Practise with a teacher, wear loose clothes, do it on a mat, do not do it after a big meal, stop if you feel dizzy (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: Madaraka Day, because it marks a step in Kenya's history and all Kenyans celebrate it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Drinking, cooking, washing, cleaning, watering plants or animals (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct use.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: People fast, keep an all-night vigil, bathe the Shiva Linga with water and milk, offer bel leaves, chant Om Namah Shivaya and visit the Mandir.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct practice.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ask permission before using a device, do not copy another's work, do not send unkind or untrue messages, and keep personal details private (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Returns extra change, pays for what he takes, brings back the correct change and does not borrow secretly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three points.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Karma means action. Good actions bring good results and unkind actions bring trouble.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for action, 1 mark for good, 1 mark for unkind.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Five great elements.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for five and 1 mark for great elements.

47. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any well-organised composition naming the festival, when it is held, what people do, what it teaches and how you feel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for name, timing, activities, meaning, and feeling.
